Name: D_0
dialogue: How have you been doing since the… y'know… since the incident?

Name: D_2
dialogue: Um…I have been fine.

Name: D_3
dialogue: Fine? Just fine?

Name: D_4
dialogue: Yeah. What's wrong with that?

Name: D_5
dialogue: When was the last time you got some sunlight? A hug? Exercised?

Name: D_6
dialogue: Bailey. You are either working, drunk, or playing ROL all day. Even as a fellow shut-in, I can acknowledge that it is too unhealthy.

Name: D_7
dialogue: That is the reason for my most recent project, Nyra. We need human interaction in some form, or else we will go insane.

Name: D_8
dialogue: No matter how introverted, we are still social creatures.

Name: D_9
dialogue: Does talking to you not count? Talking with you Alex, is more than enough socializing for me.

Name: D_10
dialogue: Besides, I am still not ready to venture out. That is what my therapist recommended.

Name: D_11
dialogue: Hold on! That is another person I still talk to, my therapist Mr.Ashborne.

Name: D_12
dialogue: That doesn't count…

Name: D_13
dialogue: That is still a person! One point in my favor!

Name: D_14
dialogue: There is no need to be concerned. I have always been a homebody. The only thing different now is a few extra pounds.

Name: D_15
dialogue: And I don't mind the weight. I chose this life, and this body is proof of my dedication to indulging myself until the day I get my isekai.

Name: D_16
dialogue: It is so much better now than back in high school when I had to worry about my appearance all the time.

Name: D_17
dialogue: Too many things to worry about when dealing with people. They're always judging your looks, how you talk, what clubs you're in, and who you're friends with.

Name: D_18
dialogue: I agree, high school was an absolute nightmare.

Name: D_19
dialogue: You remember I used to complain about my brother making me go to those wrestling classes and dragging me to the gym all the time. I hated all that.

Name: D_20
dialogue: I literally hated having to interact with all those fake people.

Name: D_21
dialogue: Hated it.

Name: D_22
dialogue: Ehhh.. If I could choose to rewrite all those years, I would just stay inside, watch anime, and play video games until I pass out.

Name: D_23
dialogue: Now I have a job where I can stay at home and do whatever I want. It is a dream come true.

Name: D_24
dialogue: Um…

Name: D_25
dialogue: I am sorry if I come off as bragging. What I mean to say is I am doing great, so there is literally no reason to worry about me.

Name: D_26
dialogue: But do you mind if I come over? To check on you.

Name: D_27
dialogue: *She frantically fiddles with her mic as if it were a hot potato thrown into her hands* HUH?

Name: D_28
dialogue: Every once in a blue moon, we will meet up at the gym or park, but it has been too long since we met face-to-face. Also, I never did get to see your new apartment. The one you moved to after you graduated from uni.

Name: D_29
dialogue: Why not kill two birds with one stone? I will come over with my laptop and we can hang out at your place.

Name: D_30
dialogue: As in here? Right now?! Oh gosh, but my place is such a mess, and so is my hair. I am in a repulsive state. Like a vibe-coded GPU compiler vib coded by a business major.

Name: D_31
dialogue: Don't come!

Name: D_32
dialogue: Alright, alright! I won't. Do you want to come over to my place? It probably isn't as messy as yours.

Name: D_33
dialogue: Umm…

Name: D_34
dialogue: Oh! I am sorry I forgot. Don't feel the need to come over. I don't mean to pressure you to go outside and stuff. But we ought to do something. I feel like we are just two rats slowly losing our minds in this urban jungle.

Name: D_35
dialogue: And us rats got to stick together. And don't have to go outside if you don't want to. I'll come over if need be.

Name: D_37
dialogue: I will try not to worry you.

Name: D_38
dialogue: Because… I don't want you to come over and stick the place up, you gooner.

Name: D_39
dialogue: Pfft! Okay dude.

Name: D_40
dialogue: I don't think you should be one to call me a gooner. I have seen your recent visual novels in your game library.

Name: D_41
dialogue: I can name a couple of BL novels if you'd like…

Name: D_42
dialogue: EEK! Stop teasing me already, you are such a bully.

Name: D_43
dialogue: Can we play ROL now?

Name: D_44
dialogue: Only if you don't troll me.

Name: D_45
dialogue: Ditto
